title: GET https://api.vox.photonind.com/integrations/entry/v1/door-calls?station=<id>&at=<ISO 8601 UTC>&window_s=<1..600> (PhotonVox, for PhotonEntry; docs/VOX.md)
description: The call from a door station that was in progress at `at` (or, if none, the one that ended last within `window_s` seconds before it), and who answered it: PhotonEntry names the person who opened a door from a call. From PhotonVox's call records; null when there is none (yet). Same token as door-stations (scope vox:entry); a station of another organization is 404.

ended_at.description: null while the call is in progress.

extension.description: The extension that answered, or the outside number's last digits for a mobile in the call flow (never the whole number).

person_id.description: The directory person the extension belongs to, if any.
